Switch to Aggressive?
These settings replace yours in Corbanu Terminal sessions and their child agents:
"now" shows this session; web search, environment, shell and roles are as loaded at launch.
• Sandbox now: commands can write to the current folder, /private/tmp, /Users/agmx1/runs/agms-G04-agmx1-20261013T175104Z/tmp; approved or allow-listed
    commands can run outside the sandbox; permission-request tools are off
  Aggressive: write only in the current folder (where the Corbanu home and the nested-launch registry stay read-only): no extra writable folders, no /
    tmp or $TMPDIR; approved commands stay inside it too; escalation and permission-request tools are off; the project's .git, .codex and .agents stay
    read-only, even with Grant once (it only lets one command write git hooks and config kept outside a .git folder and, when the current folder holds
    your home folder, start-up files, login agents and .claude settings); reading credential files (.env, .env.* and .envrc files, also ones created
    later; not .env.example, .env.sample or .env.template; SSH, cloud and CLI tokens) or Corbanu's sign-in, vault, config and history is denied to
    agent commands and is never granted, not even once (switch to Permissive in /security to allow it); on Linux and Windows a command is stopped when
    such a file appears while it runs, and a process already waiting for that file can read it in the moment before the stop; a credential file that
    is a link must be replaced with a regular file or moved out of the folder
• Approvals now: on-request (reviewer: you)
  Aggressive: untrusted: you approve every command that is not known read-only (reviewer: you, never auto-review)
• Network now: off inside the sandbox, on for commands that run outside it; web search cached
  Aggressive: off for agent commands; web search off
• Vault now: the vault store and sign-in file are readable to agent commands; only allowlisted environment variables reach agent commands (for example
    PATH, HOME, locale, terminal, proxy and tool locations; secretless_agent_launch); set others explicitly in shell_environment_policy.set; login
    profiles and shell snapshots are not used
  Aggressive: the vault store and sign-in file are unreadable to agent commands, and direct `corbanu vault …` commands are refused; secret-like

• Model keys now: Corbanu reads provider keys itself (broker_model_auth off)
  Aggressive: provider API keys from the environment or the vault are held by the isolated credential broker, which sends model requests for Corbanu
